use default
use Raster.ANIMATION
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use Colour = (red: ubyte, green: ubyte, blue: ubyte)

use Body = (
    name: string, radius: double, period: double, start: double,
    colour: Colour)

let size = 160
let years = 8.0D
let shown = 2.2D
let frames = 88

rgb(r: int, g: int, b: int) -> Colour =>
    (red = cast ubyte(r), green = cast ubyte(g), blue = cast ubyte(b))

let earth: Body = ("Earth", 1.0D, 1.0D, 100.46D, rgb(60, 110, 220))

let bodies: Body[] = [
    ("Sun", 0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D, rgb(255, 190, 40)),
    ("Mercury", 0.387D, 0.2408D, 252.25D, rgb(170, 170, 170)),
    ("Venus", 0.723D, 0.6152D, 181.98D, rgb(230, 200, 120)),
    ("Mars", 1.524D, 1.8809D, 355.45D, rgb(220, 70, 50))
]

around_sun(body: Body, year: double) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    let turns = body.start / 360.0D + year / body.period in
    let angle = 2.0D * Math.pi * turns in
    (x = body.radius * Math.cos(angle), y = body.radius * Math.sin(angle))

around_earth(body: Body, year: double) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    let p = around_sun(body, year), e = around_sun(earth, year) in
    (x = p.x - e.x, y = p.y - e.y)

turning(body: Body, from: double, to: double) -> double =>
    let a = around_earth(body, from), b = around_earth(body, to) in
    Math.atan2(a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x, a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y)

retrograde_loops(body: Body) -> int is
    let steps = cast int(years * 2000.0D)
    let loops mut = 0
    let backwards mut = false

    for step in 1..steps do
        let year = years * cast double(step) / cast double(steps)
        let previous = years * cast double(step - 1) / cast double(steps)
        let change = turning(body, previous, year)

        if change < 0.0D /\ !backwards then
            loops = loops + 1
        fi

        backwards = change < 0.0D
    od

    loops
si

year_of(frame: int) -> double =>
    shown * cast double(frame) / cast double(frames)

draw(image: IMAGE, frame: int) is
    image.clear(8ub, 8ub, 20ub)
    image.stroke(1.0D)

    for body in bodies do
        let trail =
            (0::frame)
                |> map(f => around_earth(body, year_of(f)))
                |> collect_list()

        let here = trail[trail.count - 1]
        let marker = if body.name =~ "Sun" then 4.0D else 2.5D fi

        image.colour(body.colour.red, body.colour.green, body.colour.blue)

        if trail.count > 1 then
            image.line(trail)
        fi

        image.dot(here.x, here.y, marker)
    od

    image.colour(earth.colour.red, earth.colour.green, earth.colour.blue)
    image.dot(0.0D, 0.0D, 3.5D)
si

for body in bodies do
    let loops = retrograde_loops(body)

    write_line("{body.name,-8} {loops,2} retrograde loops in {years} years")
od

let image = IMAGE(size, size)

image.view(-2.7D, -2.7D, 2.7D, 2.7D)

let animation = ANIMATION(size, size)

for frame in 0..frames do
    draw(image, frame)
    animation.add(image, 100)
od

animation.write("geocentric.png")

animation.show("geocentric.png")
